dog.description_text:
Meet Chess, a beautiful young lady looking for a loving home!

One thing we love about Chess is how distinguished she is, often lounging around and taking advantage of the comfiest spot a room has to offer!

When she’s well rested and ready to take on the day, the way to win over Chess’s heart is yummy treats! Toss some her way, and she’ll hop down and trot over. With her favorite people, Chess will come over and rub against you to thank you! She’s even been known to arch into back scratches when she’s happiest.

As a way to take in her surroundings, Chess loves to go around sniffing and rubbing up on everything she can find! It helps her find the perfect spot to lounge around once again to relax or even settle in for a quick playtime session! Chess especially loves feather toys, and will brush up on the feathers to relax. If you’re looking for a new friend to lounge around and experience life with, look no further! Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about Chess.

Chess is bonded with Blackjack so they'll need to go home together!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
